counting_arithmetic: Python unbounded integers; signed minimum uses integer min-plus with lexicographic frustration/distance objective.
root_certificate: Exact reciprocal reduction plus rational intervals; verifier checks 28 disjoint sign-changing intervals per polynomial.
numerical_geometry: Full ensemble Fisher metric Cov(S,M), Gaussian K. Four 60-digit checks with three curvature assemblies sharing moment inputs. Double grid evaluated separately.
numerical_temperature_roots: 40/65-digit nroots, coefficient-scaled residual at 80 digits; no certified complex disks.
independent_cycle_verifier: C++17, complete Gray-code enumeration, rank 29, two parity coordinates, 340 exact coefficient checks.
shared_input_between_counting_routes: Dual graph and selected cocycles derived from the supplied MTFT source.

randomness.generator: Python random.Random for integer sampling; NumPy default_rng for gauge controls. Fixed recorded seeds.

timing_scope: Kernel timings exclude graph construction, unpacking and gates; all timings are single-run observations.

prior_release_checks.scope: Four selected source test files; not the full package suite.

delivery: Research companion to the unchanged uploaded release; no upstream publication or repository mutation.
